title: build-judge-verdict contract data
description: The build-review judge's per-finding ruling at the would-be-park point (FAFF-996), a sibling of spec-judge-verdict with a build-appropriate three-outcome vocabulary OVERTURN|UPHOLD|PRODUCT_BOUNDARY. No SYNTHESIZE (the code is already written — the judge cannot compose a third code) and no correction object (a build judge never edits an artifact; a fix is the author's separate re-review path, not a judge output). Fail-loud on an outcome outside the enum (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). The founded-outcome invariants (UPHOLD/PRODUCT_BOUNDARY require a non-empty rationale; PRODUCT_BOUNDARY additionally requires a non-empty product_gap_citation; OVERTURN requires an empty product_gap_citation) are enforced in the compute fn via violations (exit 1).
